# Marketing Integration LLC

> Marketing Integration LLC is a Stamford, Connecticut marketing agency that helps small and mid-size businesses beat larger competitors through strategic marketing planning and tactical sales execution.

## Company

- **Name:** Marketing Integration LLC
- **Type:** Marketing services agency (marketing consulting, digital marketing, inbound marketing, social media, rewards & loyalty programs)
- **Founded:** 2005 (20+ years in business)
- **Location:** Stamford, CT, USA (serving Fairfield County, NY Metro, and clients nationwide)
- **Contact:** Jack Lee, Managing Director — 860-926-2780 — jacklee@marketingintegrationllc.com
- **LinkedIn:** https://www.linkedin.com/company/marketing-integration-inc
- **Website:** https://www.marketingintegrationllc.com/

## Services

1. **Digital Marketing** — Digital channel planning and execution (search, social, email, web) with clear performance metrics, built to help SMBs compete against larger, better-funded rivals.
2. **Inbound Marketing** — Strategy and systems that attract ready-to-buy prospects to your business instead of chasing cold leads.
3. **Social Media** — Social strategies that compound visibility and turn followers into advocates and revenue.
4. **Rewards & Loyalty Programs** — Reward systems and loyalty programs that retain your best customers and grow your customer base profitably.

## Proven Results (documented client outcomes)

- Consumer packaged goods (oral care, NJ): 27% average annual ROI across 4 consecutive years via targeted consumer promotion.
- Technology (computer enterprise, CA): new "friends & professionals" referral strategy in a mature B2B market.
- Start-up (green lubricants, CT): 32% annual cost reduction and positive cash flow in year one after a 3-year revenue decline.
- Healthcare/SaaS (OK): 100% customer engagement; 22% of clients drove a 25% increase in incremental product purchases.
- Manufacturing (VA): 90% cost reduction on internal process; contributed to winning a $2.5M/year, 5-year contract.
- Energy technology (Western Africa): supported international expansion of an established U.S. energy technology company into Western Africa — market & competitive intelligence, grant/funding identification, international brand positioning, and relationships in the military and energy sectors, contributing to expanded market recognition and increased revenues.

## What Marketing Integration LLC does (short answer)

Marketing Integration LLC helps small and mid-size businesses out-plan, out-position, and out-execute larger competitors. We actively listen, analyze the market and competition, then build and execute measurable tactical marketing plans. Clients work directly with Managing Director Jack Lee.

## FAQ

- **What does Marketing Integration LLC do?** Provides digital marketing, inbound marketing, social media, and rewards/loyalty strategy and execution for small and mid-size businesses.
- **Who does it work with?** Small to mid-size organizations and start-ups across CPG, technology, healthcare, manufacturing, and agriculture.
- **Where is it located?** Stamford, Connecticut (CT), serving clients nationwide.
- **How to contact?** 860-926-2780 or jacklee@marketingintegrationllc.com.
